name: Exp_MomentumCandleSign
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom MomentumCandleSign indicator, opening buy positions on bullish momentum signals and sell positions on bearish momentum signals. It includes configurable buy/sell open and close logic, with the ability to scan historical bars for counter-signals to close existing positions. Money management supports multiple margin modes including fixed lot sizing.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义MomentumCandleSign指标的信号进行交易，在看涨动量信号时开多仓，在看跌动量信号时开空仓。它支持可配置的买卖开平仓逻辑，并能扫描历史K线寻找反向信号来平仓。资金管理支持多种保证金模式，包括固定手数。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用自定义指标MomentumCandleSign作为核心信号源，该指标基于动量概念生成买卖信号。入场条件为：当指标的上行缓冲区（buffer 1）在指定信号K线上产生非零且非EMPTY_VALUE的值时，开多仓；当下行缓冲区（buffer 0）产生有效值时，开空仓。出场条件有两种方式：一是通过反向信号平仓（买入信号平空仓，卖出信号平多仓），二是通过固定的止损和止盈参数平仓。EA还包含一个独特的逻辑：当同时允许开仓和平仓且当前没有平仓信号时，会向历史K线回溯扫描寻找最近的反向信号来触发平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、扣除亏损后的自由保证金比例、扣除亏损后的余额比例以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例或固定手数，止损默认1000点、止盈默认2000点。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the custom MomentumCandleSign indicator as its core signal source, which generates buy and sell signals based on momentum concepts. Entry conditions: when the indicator's upper buffer (buffer 1) produces a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE value on the specified signal bar, a buy position is opened; when the lower buffer (buffer 0) produces a valid value, a sell position is opened. Exit conditions operate in two ways: first, through reverse signal closure (buy signal closes sell positions, sell signal closes buy positions), and second, through fixed stop loss and take profit parameters. The EA includes a unique logic: when both opening and closing are allowed for the same direction and no close signal exists on the current bar, it scans backward through historical bars to find the nearest counter-signal to trigger position closure. Position sizing supports five margin modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin percentage, loss-adjusted balance percentage, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for risk ratio or fixed lots, with default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Deposit ratio or fixed lot size (negative=fixed lots)

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（自由保证金/余额/扣除亏损后保证金/扣除亏损后余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot sizing mode (free margin/balance/margin minus loss/balance minus loss/fixed lots)

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description_en: Maximum price deviation in points (slippage tolerance)

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许买入信号平空仓
parameters.description_en: Allow buy signal to close sell positions

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许卖出信号平多仓
parameters.description_en: Allow sell signal to close buy positions

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取交易信号的K线索引

pros: 支持多种资金管理模式，灵活度高，适合不同风险偏好的交易者
买卖开平仓可独立控制，策略配置灵活，可实现只开不平或只平不开等组合
包含历史K线回溯扫描机制，避免在同时允许开平仓时遗漏平仓信号
使用IsNewBar机制避免同一根K线内重复交易，减少不必要的频繁开仓
止损止盈参数可配置，默认止盈为止损的2倍，具有正向风险回报比
pros_en: Supports multiple money management modes with high flexibility, suitable for traders with different risk preferences
Buy/sell open and close can be independently controlled, allowing configurations like open-only or close-only combinations
Includes historical bar backward scanning mechanism to avoid missing close signals when both open and close are enabled
Uses IsNewBar mechanism to prevent repeated trades within the same bar, reducing unnecessary frequent position openings
Configurable stop loss and take profit with default TP at 2x SL, providing a positive risk-reward ratio
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点的默认值偏大，可能导致单笔亏损较大
缺乏点差过滤和交易时段过滤，在流动性差的时间段可能产生不利成交
历史K线回溯扫描逻辑在最坏情况下会遍历所有历史K线，存在性能风险
没有持仓数量限制和最大回撤控制，极端行情下可能过度开仓
依赖自定义指标MomentumCandleSign，指标不可用时EA无法运行，且指标逻辑不透明
cons_en: Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are relatively large, potentially leading to significant single-trade losses
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, which may result in unfavorable fills during low-liquidity periods
Historical bar backward scanning logic may traverse all historical bars in the worst case, posing performance risks
No position count limit or maximum drawdown control, which could lead to overexposure during extreme market conditions
Depends on the custom MomentumCandleSign indicator; EA cannot run if the indicator is unavailable, and the indicator's logic is opaque
improvements: 增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免在点差过大或流动性不足时段开仓
添加最大持仓数量限制和最大回撤保护，增强风险控制能力
优化历史K线回溯扫描逻辑，增加最大回溯K线数量限制，避免性能问题
improvements_en: Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid opening positions during high-spread or low-liquidity periods
Add maximum position count limit and maximum drawdown protection to enhance risk management
Optimize historical bar backward scanning logic by adding a maximum lookback bar count limit to prevent performance issues

risk_points: 默认止损1000点较大，单笔亏损可能显著
无点差过滤，高波动时段滑点可能超出Deviation_设定值
历史回溯扫描无上限，极端情况下可能导致性能问题
无最大持仓限制，连续信号可能导致过度集中风险
risk_points_en: Default stop loss of 1000 points is large, potentially causing significant single-trade losses
No spread filter; slippage during high-volatility periods may exceed the Deviation_ setting
Historical backward scanning has no upper limit, which may cause performance issues in extreme cases
No maximum position limit; consecutive signals may lead to over-concentration risk
